org: Egyptian Cabinet Information and Decision Support Center
description: Built a Prime Minister-sponsored retrieval-augmented chatbot that assesses emerging rumors on the national “Chat Egypt” platform, as the sole developer during the internship; the system was later extended and deployed. Also built pipelines for automated verification of news content from trusted governmental and media sources.

Helped develop an indoor navigation system integrated into the COP27 mobile app with MCIT and UN engineers, and managed the UN Climate Change YouTube channel from the conference’s Master Control Room.
